name: discovery-desk
description: A discovery desk panel (/discovery) for UX prototype journeys: walk a journey step by step on iOS or Android, answer its open questions, decisions and ADRs on cards Claude publishes, check the prototype against the vault with drift findings and a vault-first guard, browse the kit's hub (experience map, personas, questions, story, progress), and hand the answers back to be recorded in the vault first.

folder.title: Desk folder
folder.description: Folder in the project, relative to its root, that holds the walks (pending/, reviewed/) and the walk notes (notes/)

prototypeRoot.title: Prototype root
prototypeRoot.description: Where to look for prototypes: a folder (relative to the project root, or absolute) whose subfolders each hold a prototype.js or a UX Prototype/prototype.js. Empty: the project root

vault.title: Vault name
vault.description: The vault the outcome is recorded in first. Empty: the vault the register names (initiative.vault in prototype.js)

defaultOs.title: Default phone
defaultOs.description: The phone a journey opens on: ios or android

autoOpen.title: Open the desk when Claude publishes a walk
autoOpen.description: Opens the panel on the new walk, unless you are in the middle of another one

handOff.title: Hand submitted walks to Claude
handOff.description: On submit, queue a prompt asking Claude to apply the outcome, the record first (it still asks before writing)

selectableText.title: Selectable text
selectableText.description: On the desktop, draw card and caption text so it can be selected and copied (links then show their address instead of opening)

validator.title: Prototype validator
validator.description: The project's own check, run from the project root with the prototype folder added (e.g. node path/to/validate_prototype.js). Its ERROR and warn lines become findings. Empty: the desk's own checks only

validatorOffline.title: Validator: without the record
validatorOffline.description: Arguments that run the validator without reading the record (shown as Run without the record). Empty: no such button

vaultRoot.title: Vault folder (read only)
vaultRoot.description: The vault on disk, read only: drift quotes are checked against its notes and the catalogue is fingerprinted. Empty: neither

autoValidate.title: Check after Claude edits a prototype
autoValidate.description: At the end of a turn that edited a prototype, run the checks and put what they find on the desk

guardMode.title: Vault-first guard
guardMode.description: When Claude edits prototype.js or a journey before writing the record in that turn: off, warn (Claude is reminded) or block (the edit is refused)

vaultWriteTools.title: Record-writing tools
vaultWriteTools.description: A pattern for the tools that write the record; a call to one counts as the record written this turn

valueWords.title: Value-out wording
valueWords.description: A pattern for wording that suggests something of value leaves the product; each hit is a finding to read. Empty: not checked

figurePattern.title: Figures to label
figurePattern.description: A pattern for prices and payouts; a journey that shows one and never says placeholder is flagged. Empty: not checked

kitFolder.title: Prototype kit folder
kitFolder.description: Where the shared prototype kit lives (relative to the project root, or absolute); Open on iOS / Android tells Claude to start the kit's server from there. Empty: the project's launch configuration

scaffold.title: Scaffold command
scaffold.description: The project's script that creates a new initiative's prototype folder (e.g. node path/to/scaffold_initiative.js), named to Claude by New initiative. Empty: Claude finds the project's own way

questionStatuses.title: Question statuses
questionStatuses.description: Comma-separated, the undecided status first and the decided one second

decisionStatuses.title: Decision statuses
decisionStatuses.description: Comma-separated: proposed, decided, rejected (in that order)
